heading: Enterprise Microsoft Transformation That Pays for Itself
subtitle: For regulated businesses in financial services, insurance, and healthcare, we turn Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics, Power Platform, and Copilot into a connected operating system that reduces cost, accelerates decisions, and scales with your organization.
overview: Most enterprises already have Microsoft licenses. Most are using less than 40 percent of what they are paying for. The gap between what your Microsoft investment costs and what it actually delivers is not a technology problem. It is an integration, governance, and adoption problem. Productivity tools operate in silos. Data sits in formats that AI cannot read. Copilot is deployed without governance, creating compliance exposure. Azure environments grow without cost controls. Business applications run in parallel with no shared data layer. We close that gap. Futran Solutions works with financial services, insurance, and healthcare organizations to architect Microsoft environments where every product works in concert.
